declarations.docstring: A basic relation used to pass between the underlying indexed objects.
Any two indexed objects are connected by a finite chain of elementary transitions, with stationary steps permitted.
Under the stated invariance hypotheses, the submodule is stable when an indexed element is replaced along an elementary transition.
The induced basis shear expands the displayed indexed symmetric-power element by summing over subsets of positions carrying the target index.
The invertible basis shear that adds the i-th basis vector at the j-th coordinate.
The linear basis shear that changes the j-th basis vector by adding the i-th one.
The formula for the basis shear on a single basis vector.
The underlying linear map of the invertible shear agrees with the associated basis shear.
Changing a selected target-index position to the source index yields a nonzero coordinate after the induced shear.
